output.explanation: Expanded modular-core; no diagrams were left unchanged. The central tree now distinguishes module contents from owned instances, nests Surface's execution resources and Terminal's screen storage, and keeps shared modules independent. Two adjacent diagrams elaborate process/IO and rendering, connected at their Surface ownership nodes and across their shared-state dependency. Source checks at the pinned commit clarified public versus private declarations, corrected the POSIX reader into gather/parse stages, confirmed Exec is the only implemented IO backend, distinguished State from terminal ownership, and preserved SharedGridSet.ref's documented non-thread-safe contract. The checkout was unchanged.

termio - Surface-owned execution, module exported by src/termio.zig
|
|-- Public Termio: init/deinit, processOutput, queueMessage, resize, getProcessInfo
|   |-- Owns Terminal, Backend, DerivedConfig and persistent StreamHandler.Stream
|   |-- Borrows renderer.State and renderer/surface mailboxes
|   `-- processOutput: acquire State.mutex, parse bytes, schedule repaint
|       `-- Private processOutputLocked: inspector tracing or bulk nextSlice
|
|-- Backend - public tagged union; only exec is implemented at this commit
|   `-- Exec - PTY/command transport
|       |-- Private Subprocess: command, PTY and shell-integration lifecycle
|       |-- Public ReadThread: platform-specific read pipeline
|       |   |-- POSIX io-gather: read/poll into bounded rotating buffers
|       |   |-- POSIX io-reader: consume batches -> Termio.processOutput
|       |   |   `-- yieldToDemand between batches lets renderer acquire the lock
|       |   `-- Windows: serial blocking read/process loop, no gather stage
|       `-- threadExit stops subprocess and joins the reader pipeline
|
|-- Public Thread + Message/Mailbox - asynchronous write/control plane
|   |-- threadMain runs the writer event loop; backend performs PTY writes
|   |-- Private timers: coalesced resize, selection scroll, sync-output timeout
|   `-- Surface writes and VT replies enter the same control path
|
|-- Public StreamHandler - application-aware VT adapter
|   |-- Stream = terminal.Stream(StreamHandler); state survives across reads
|   |-- Retains APC/DCS handlers, clipboard transactions/grants, optional tmux viewer
|   |-- -> terminal edits/protocol types; termio mailbox for replies/control
|   `-- -> Surface mailbox for title, clipboard and resize requests
|
|-- -> Rendering: shared State mutex, repaint wakeup and renderer mailbox
|-- -> Surface: child-status messages; -> Config: derived settings/Exec options
`-- Source: src/termio.zig:20-33; termio/Termio.zig:29-74,705-763,857;

|-- Public Renderer = GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI)

|   |-- Terminal pointer, mutex pointer, inspector, preedit and mouse overlay data
